# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC29 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Worktree: `/path/to/wscrpt`

## Scope

RC29 adds a bounded read-only current-file Git History view, extending the editor's streamlined IDE version-control surface without introducing branch switching, reset, pull, push, or other broad Git mutation workflows.

- `Esc v H` opens Git File History for the active file.
- `:file-history`, `:filehistory`, `:git-file-history`, and `:history-file` open the same view.
- The command scopes history to the active file using `git log --follow -- path`.
- The view shows repository path, branch label, and at most the newest 100 commits touching the file.
- Untitled or virtual buffers are refused before file history can run.
- The view is read-only and cannot edit source text.
- The command runs directly through the existing bounded Git runner, never through a shell.
- It does not stage, commit, switch, pull, push, reset, tag, or discard working-tree content.
- The keymap reference, action footer, README, and iPad QA matrix expose the new file-history route.

## Proof boundary

This checkpoint is locally verified on the host Rust/PTY path. It is not a real iPad Magic Keyboard, Blink Shell, mosh, SSH, tmux, clipboard, touch, reconnect, or real language-server proof. Those remain manual QA gates in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
